lines.zh: 我贴着海床游，沙从腹下过。
lines.en: I swim along the seabed, sand slipping under my belly.

lines.zh: 头顶那盏灯，照亮前面一小块。
lines.en: The lamp above my head lights a small patch ahead.

lines.zh: 慢慢来，深海不催我。
lines.en: Slowly now; the deep sea doesn't hurry me.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一摆，淤泥就散开。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and the silt scatters.

lines.zh: 这里没有光，我自己带着。
lines.en: There's no light here; I bring my own.

lines.zh: 绕过那根沉船的桅杆。
lines.en: I swim around the sunken mast.

lines.zh: 水压把骨头压得发闷。
lines.en: The pressure makes my bones feel dull.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，可从不迷路。
lines.en: I swim slowly, but I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼从嘴边溜走了。
lines.en: A school of small fish slips past my mouth.

lines.zh: 越往下，水越冷越黑。
lines.en: The deeper I go, the colder and darker it gets.

lines.zh: 我不追，等它们自己靠近。
lines.en: I don't chase; I wait for them to come close.

lines.zh: 前面的沟，我熟得很。
lines.en: I know that trench up ahead quite well.

lines.zh: 光线晃了一下，是我转了个身。
lines.en: The light swayed; I turned my body.

lines.zh: 别跟丢了，暗处只有我一盏。
lines.en: Don't fall behind; I'm the only lamp in the dark.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一尾巴。
lines.en: I move forward one tail-length.

lines.zh: 暗处有块石头，我绕过去。
lines.en: A rock in the dark; I go around it.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then slowly close it.

lines.zh: 那盏灯一明一暗，像在喘气。
lines.en: The lure flickers as if it were breathing.

lines.zh: 深海很静，静得能听见自己。
lines.en: The deep is quiet enough to hear myself.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙里，只留灯在外。
lines.en: I settle in the sand with only my lure showing.

lines.zh: 小鱼围着灯转，还不知道。
lines.en: Little fish circle the lure, still unaware.

lines.zh: 牙齿向内倒着，收不回来。
lines.en: My teeth lean inward and can't be drawn back.

lines.zh: 我数海面上落下来的光点。
lines.en: I count the specks of light drifting down from above.

lines.zh: 这片黑，我待了很多年。
lines.en: I've spent many years in this blackness.

lines.zh: 身体太沉，懒得动。
lines.en: My body is too heavy; I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 有东西擦过我的侧线。
lines.en: Something brushed along my lateral line.

lines.zh: 我把灯熄了一会儿。
lines.en: I put the lure out for a while.

lines.zh: 沙子钻进鳃里，有点痒。
lines.en: Sand got into my gills; it tickles.

lines.zh: 上面那些影子，都不下来。
lines.en: Those shadows up there never come down.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我几乎像块石头。
lines.en: At rest, I'm almost like a stone.

lines.zh: 你潜得这么深，肺受得住？
lines.en: You dive this deep — can your lungs take it?

lines.zh: 你的灯比我的亮，真刺眼。
lines.en: Your light is brighter than mine; it stings.

lines.zh: 我从沙里抬起头看你。
lines.en: I lift my head from the sand to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼搅起了一层泥。
lines.en: Your fins stirred up a layer of mud.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的嘴很大。
lines.en: Don't come too close; my mouth is large.

lines.zh: 你带着玻璃罩，是有备而来。
lines.en: You brought a glass mask — you came prepared.

lines.zh: 我在你身上闻到了船的味道。
lines.en: I smell a boat on you.

lines.zh: 你一直在看我的灯，对吧。
lines.en: You keep staring at my lure, don't you.

lines.zh: 眼睛小，不等于看不见你。
lines.en: Small eyes don't mean I can't see you.

lines.zh: 你是来找夜视的，我猜。
lines.en: You came looking for night sight, I'd guess.

lines.zh: 鳞片掉了几片，不碍事。
lines.en: A few scales came off; no matter.

lines.zh: 水里的疼，散得很慢。
lines.en: Pain in water fades very slowly.

lines.zh: 这一击把我掀得肚皮朝天。
lines.en: That hit flipped me belly-up.

lines.zh: 你打中了我的侧腹。
lines.en: You hit my flank.

lines.zh: 别碰灯，那里最敏感。
lines.en: Don't touch the lure; it's the tenderest part.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的味道。
lines.en: That one — I've memorized your scent.

lines.zh: 伤口在水里泛着暗红。
lines.en: The wound blooms dark red in the water.

lines.zh: 我往深处沉了半尺，稳住身子。
lines.en: I sink half a foot deeper and steady myself.

lines.zh: 想让我松口？你打错地方了。
lines.en: Want me to let go? You hit the wrong spot.

lines.zh: 还在动，那就还没完。
lines.en: Still moving, so it isn't over.

lines.zh: 那枚东西在闪，递过来。
lines.en: That thing glints; hand it over.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，我从来不拒绝。
lines.en: Shiny things — I never refuse them.

lines.zh: 给我一颗，我看得更清。
lines.en: Give me one, and I'll see more clearly.

lines.zh: 你手里那点光，晃得我心痒。
lines.en: That light in your hand makes me restless.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我已经张好嘴了。
lines.en: Don't pull it back; my mouth is already open.

lines.zh: 闪亮的，比鱼好吃吗？
lines.en: Is a shiny thing tastier than fish?

lines.zh: 我咬住就不松口，想清楚。
lines.en: I won't let go once I bite; think it through.

lines.zh: 那枚发亮的小东西，给我。
lines.en: That little glowing thing — give it to me.

lines.zh: 我吃下去，眼睛会亮一点。
lines.en: If I eat it, my eyes will brighten a bit.

lines.zh: 你抖什么，我又不咬手。
lines.en: Why shake? I won't bite your hand.

lines.zh: 撞到了，我的灯晃了一下。
lines.en: We bumped; my lure swayed.

lines.zh: 水下看不清，我不是故意。
lines.en: I can't see well underwater; it wasn't on purpose.

lines.zh: 你踢到我的鳍了，轻点。
lines.en: You kicked my fin; easy.

lines.zh: 我这身皮，撞着像湿布袋。
lines.en: Hitting this hide feels like a wet sack.

lines.zh: 让让，我要往那条缝里钻。
lines.en: Move; I want into that crevice.

lines.zh: 撞一下不要紧，别压我的灯。
lines.en: A bump is fine, but don't crush my lure.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖顶到我牙上了。
lines.en: Your knee knocked against my teeth.

lines.zh: 这片沙是我的位置，别挤。
lines.en: This sand is my spot; don't crowd it.

lines.zh: 我转身太慢，撞上了礁石。
lines.en: I turn too slowly and hit the reef.

lines.zh: 挤过来也没用，我不让路。
lines.en: Squeezing past won't help; I won't move.

lines.zh: 你也是鮟鱇？灯的颜色不对。
lines.en: You're an angler too? Your lure is the wrong color.

lines.zh: 两颗灯并排，海底就亮些。
lines.en: Two lures side by side brighten the seabed.

lines.zh: 跟我去更深的地方，那里没人。
lines.en: Come deeper with me; no one goes there.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕着你游一圈。
lines.en: I swim one slow circle around you.

lines.zh: 你的牙齿和我的差不多钝。
lines.en: Your teeth are about as blunt as mine.

lines.zh: 我们不追，只等同一群鱼。
lines.en: We don't chase; we wait for the same school.

lines.zh: 靠近些，让灯碰着灯。
lines.en: Come closer; let our lures touch.

lines.zh: 深海里的伴，找起来很费劲。
lines.en: A partner in the deep is hard to find.

lines.zh: 你愿意守着这片暗吗？
lines.en: Would you keep watch over this dark with me?

lines.zh: 别急，我们有的是时间。
lines.en: No rush; we have plenty of time down here.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起来，放回沙里。
lines.en: I pick it up in my mouth and set it in the sand.

lines.zh: 亮的东西，得藏起来。
lines.en: Shiny things should be hidden.

lines.zh: 沉下去的那枚，归我了。
lines.en: The one that sank belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我把它压在腹鳍底下。
lines.en: I tuck it under my pelvic fin.

lines.zh: 掉进我窝里的，都算我的。
lines.en: Whatever falls into my hollow is mine.

lines.zh: 这颗带着船板的味道。
lines.en: This one smells of ship timber.

lines.zh: 收好了，别让小鱼叼走。
lines.en: Stowed away; don't let the small fish take it.

lines.zh: 我把它埋在沙里，记住位置。
lines.en: I bury it in the sand and remember the spot.

lines.zh: 一堆了，闪闪地看着舒服。
lines.en: Quite a pile now; it's nice to look at.

lines.zh: 我从不嫌亮的东西多。
lines.en: I never complain about having too many shiny things.

lines.zh: 有东西落水了，声音很闷。
lines.en: Something hit the water — a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 那片光在动，不是鱼鳞。
lines.en: That glow moves, and it isn't fish scales.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见上面的影子。
lines.en: I look up and see a shape above.

lines.zh: 有人在下潜，气泡一串。
lines.en: Someone is descending — a string of bubbles.

lines.zh: 味道变了，水里有铁。
lines.en: The water's taste changed; there's iron in it.

lines.zh: 我的灯转向那一边。
lines.en: My lure swivels toward that side.

lines.zh: 沉寂被搅开了，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The quiet is stirred up; I don't like it.

lines.zh: 有猎物自己送上门了。
lines.en: Something has delivered itself as prey.

lines.zh: 沙上多了一串脚印。
lines.en: A line of footprints appeared in the sand.

lines.zh: 靠近我的窝了，停下来。
lines.en: You're nearing my hollow — stop there.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张嘴，就这么大。
lines.en: I open my mouth slowly; it's this big.

lines.zh: 再近一点，进了我嘴边。
lines.en: A bit closer — you're at my lips.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的灯就往左。
lines.en: You go left, my lure goes left.

lines.zh: 我不追，等你游进我的范围。
lines.en: I don't chase; I wait for you to swim into range.

lines.zh: 那盏灯一直亮着，你看着它。
lines.en: The lure stays lit; you watch it.

lines.zh: 沙子底下，我把自己埋好了。
lines.en: Under the sand, I've buried myself well.

lines.zh: 你还在犹豫，我已经决定。
lines.en: You're still hesitating; I've decided.

lines.zh: 水流朝我这边，你逆不过来。
lines.en: The current runs my way; you can't fight it.

lines.zh: 牙齿碰到一起，轻轻一声。
lines.en: My teeth meet with a soft click.

lines.zh: 别回头，后面没有出口。
lines.en: Don't look back; there's no exit behind you.

lines.zh: 一口咬下去，水都震了一下。
lines.en: One bite, and the water itself shook.

lines.zh: 我的牙往里倒，咬住就吞。
lines.en: My teeth lean inward; once I bite, I swallow.

lines.zh: 你挣得越狠，卡得越紧。
lines.en: The harder you struggle, the tighter it lodges.

lines.zh: 这一下，连沙都翻起来了。
lines.en: That one turned up the sand.

lines.zh: 我不撕咬，我整口含住。
lines.en: I don't tear; I take you in whole.

lines.zh: 水花一炸，什么都看不见了。
lines.en: A burst of water, and nothing is visible.

lines.zh: 别用手指挡，那没用。
lines.en: Don't block with your fingers; it won't help.

lines.zh: 我合嘴的声音，你听见了。
lines.en: You heard my jaws close.

lines.zh: 吞不下就吐出来，我试过。
lines.en: I've tried spitting out what won't fit.

lines.zh: 这回只咬到你的护甲。
lines.en: This time I only bit your armor.

lines.zh: 我在最深的一层水里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the deepest layer of water.

lines.zh: 灯先亮起来，身体才动。
lines.en: The lure lights first; then the body stirs.

lines.zh: 从海沟的裂缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a crack in the trench.

lines.zh: 上面很远，这里很黑。
lines.en: The surface is far; it's dark here.

lines.zh: 我落进沙里，扬起一点灰。
lines.en: I land in the sand and raise a little dust.

lines.zh: 冷水灌进鳃，我醒了。
lines.en: Cold water floods my gills, and I wake.

lines.zh: 这片海底还很空，正好。
lines.en: This seabed is still empty — just right.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去，找到位置。
lines.en: I sink slowly and find my place.

lines.zh: 谁把灯放在这儿的？是我。
lines.en: Who left a lamp here? I did.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这条沟有主了。
lines.en: From today, this trench has an owner.

lines.zh: 水里也能烧？我的鳍缩了。
lines.en: Fire underwater too? My fins curled.

lines.zh: 摔在沙上，浑身都震麻了。
lines.en: Hitting the sand numbed my whole body.

lines.zh: 我就在水里，你让我怎么溺？
lines.en: I live in water; how would I drown?

lines.zh: 水被炸开，我翻出去老远。
lines.en: The water burst and flung me far.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的背鳍。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 那道光钻进我鳃里，很难受。
lines.en: That light crawled into my gills; it hurts.

lines.zh: 饿一阵没事，我本来吃得少。
lines.en: A little hunger is fine; I eat little anyway.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我的灯灭了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sea, and my lure went out.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我喘不上气。
lines.en: There's no water here; I can't breathe.
